angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 65,117,520 km at 5301.60 pc = 0.16 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AN Aur: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 5301.6 +/- 463.4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 5301.6 +/- 463.4 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2494 +/- 0.0183 mas (same row, RUWE 1.21), 13.6 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 93.6 +/- 8.1 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AN Aur: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 93.6 +/- 8.1 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 65,117,520 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 153 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 14, Name='AN Aur', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 153 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 14, Name='AN Aur', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 153 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.94 from 2011AJ....141...53S; the 2 published values span log g 1.94 to 2.13, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.2% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011AJ....141...53S)
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, V* AN Aur: spectral type F6
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, V* AN Aur: main object type cC*, Classical Cepheid Variable

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
